messages:
mia: Hey runtime team — prepping launch post + webinar. Need a tiny, self-contained smokepack we can hand to press and use in slides. Specifically: raw input payloads, raw model outputs, the exact run command + env, commit hash, container image, quantized variant artifacts (if any), warmup profile, and a short chain-of-custody note we can paste into docs. Can you confirm what you can provide and any gaps? :pray:

sam: @mia yep. we can produce that. quick q: which model variant do you want as the primary artifact — full fp16 or the 4-bit quantized we showed earlier?

mia: ideally both, but if we need to pick one for the press pack, start with fp16 and include 4-bit as an appendix.

jules: will do. checklist i'll produce:
- inputs (3 short examples + 1 long-context)
- raw outputs (JSONL with tokens + final text)
- run command + env + commit hash
- image: registry.redwood/runtime:2026-03-smokepack
- quantized artifacts: model-v2-q4.bin (sha256: abc...)
- warmup script + observed cold/warm latencies
- short note: who ran it, when, and which GPU pool

Here is the exact command i'll run (copyable):
```
RUNTIME_IMAGE=registry.redwood/runtime:2026-03-smokepack
docker run --rm -e MODEL_PATH=/mnt/models/model-v2-fp16 \
  -v /artifacts:/artifacts $RUNTIME_IMAGE \
  /usr/local/bin/run_inference --input /artifacts/inputs.jsonl --output /artifacts/outputs.jsonl \
  --batch-size 1 --max-tokens 256 --seed 42
```

sam: FYI we have a backlog on the dedicated gpu pool this wk — if you need SLA turnaround, mark this P0 and i'll bump to reserved capacity. Otherwise i can queue a reproducible run on shared infra (expected finish ~4h).

alice: timeline: marketing needs press-ready zip (artifacts + short README) by EOD Wednesday PST for the reporter embargo. can you confirm whether 4h run meets that?

jules: @alice probably yes if we start now on shared infra. but quantized variants take longer to export (extra 1-2h). if you need both by EOD, pls allow P0.

mia: OK — make it P0. also include a one-paragraph chain-of-custody we can paste into the launch notes (who executed, dataset used for inputs, and whether any postprocessing was applied).

sam: copying the run into the reserved queue now. i'll post the artifact link and sha256 once done. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build queued: smokepack-run #4821 (reserved-gpu). Estimated completion: ~2h. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/4821

jules: quick note on reproducibility — please use these exact seeds and env vars when trying to reproduce: SEED=42, DONT_SHUFFLE=1, BATCH=1. i'll put that into the README.

mia: perfect. thank you all. once artifacts live, i'll do a quick content pass and confirm for press.

sam: got it, will update thread with artifact S3 links + checksums when ready.

jules: uploaded preliminary pack to s3://redwood-marketing/smokepacks/2026-03-21-v1.zip (private). will share presigned link after final checks.

mia: awesome — appreciate it :celebrate:
